thread:
Samira (partnerships): Heads-up: Constellation Systems preview units arriving next Tue. Need NDA signed, customs cleared, bench acceptance criteria, and a short feedback template. Who owns bench sign-off? cc @Owen @Hana @Yu
Owen (partner-ops): Ill take shipping and customs. Carrier ETA Tue evening. Please confirm rack U and sustained power draw so I can book PDUs.
Hana (hw-eng): Hardware: 2 nodes, 1U each. Power: 1.0kW sustained per rack. Firmware tags: cs-2026-05-stable and cs-2026-06-rc (perf fixes). Recommend baseline on stable then upgrade to rc for perf runs. Need serials and firmware checksums on arrival.
Yu (bench): I can own bench validation. Proposed minimal matrix: single-stream latency (seq=4096), batch4 throughput, 4h soak, and a 250-sample quality sweep vs redwood/v1.2. Acceptance: p99 within 10% and quality delta <1%. Also add a micro-benchmark for quant kernel timing. Runner snippet for infra:
```
./bench_runner --model redwood/v1.2 --seq 4096 --batch 1 --out s3://redwood-preview/constellation/metrics.json
```
We will capture p50/p95/p99 and token-level traces.
Diego (legal): NDA draft received. I'll redline telemetry scope and embargo clauses, and request explicit no-access to raw request payloads. Target: countersigned NDA by Mon EOD.
SchedBot: Calendar event "Constellation Preview - Lab Week" Tue-Thu created. Invitees: Samira, Owen, Hana, Yu, Diego.
Samira (partnerships): Action items: Diego - NDA by Mon; Owen - shipping + customs by Tue; Hana - firmware + kernel capture by Wed; Yu - bench doc + runner by Mon AM. I'll run a day-zero sync Mon 09:00.
Owen (partner-ops): Shipping labels uploaded; will post tracking when carrier confirms pickup.
Hana (hw-eng): If we observe kernel or PCIe anomalies, capture dmesg/lspci and vendor modules. I'll reserve isolated nodes for passthrough if required.
Yu (bench): Potential blocker: cs-2026-06-rc changes quant scheduling; will run micro-bench to isolate timing differences and flag regressions early.
Samira (partnerships): Thanks team. Keeping this thread as primary coordination and day-zero notes. :white_check_mark:
